mapper.select: select id as notificationId, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, like_count as likeCount, last_like_time as lastLikeTime from notification_like where receiver_id = #{receiverId} order by last_like_time desc
select id, content from statuses where id in #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select id, content from comments where id in #{id} and is_deleted = 0

select a.user_id as id, u.nickname, u.avatar, DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as likeTime from attitudes a join users u on a.user_id = u.id where a.target_type = #{targetType} and a.target_id = #{targetId} order by a.created_at desc limit 20
select target_type from attitudes where target_id = #{targetId} limit 1
